name: renovando
description: Renovando a Vinha do Senhor: API do app, sistema administrativo (servidor, painel web e app) e app mobile.

scripts.admin: concurrently -k -n servidor,painel -c magenta,blue "npm run dev -w renovando-admin-servidor" "npm run dev -w renovando-admin-painel"
scripts.admin:producao: npm run admin:build && npm start -w renovando-admin-servidor
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w renovando-api -w renovando-admin-servidor && npm run build -w renovando-admin-painel
